headline: Big Monday: World Series Game 3 (Brewers @ Rays, Milwaukee leads 2-0), WNBA Finals Game 5 (Dream @ Valkyries, tied 2-2), and Cowboys @ Eagles on Monday Night Football. All three start around 5:00 PM PT.

record.label: Last board (Fri 10/23)
record.note: World Series Game 1 went our way: Chourio went 2-for-4 with a run and an RBI, Misiorowski had just 3 strikeouts, and the Brewers won 3-2. The Timberwolves won by 22. The Wizards (+7.5) and Bucks missed. The board is now back above even overall (about +0.4u).

notes: No bet is a lock. 'Confidence' runs 1–5, and nothing on this board is above a 3.
The board is roughly back to break-even after a rough first week. Keep stakes the same; don't chase.
Odds move. Skip any pick whose price is past the 'playable to' number in its reasoning.
Bet only what you can afford to lose. Help: 1-800-GAMBLER.

sections.label: Best of the Day
sections.slate: The strongest edges across today's card. Friday these went 2-0. Today: the Rays at home behind Peralta, and the Under in a WNBA Finals Game 5 between two elite defenses.

straight.reasoning: SI and Covers both pick Tampa. Freddy Peralta has a 1.08 ERA in three playoff starts and has gone at least 14 outs in each. He beat Cleveland twice for us in the ALCS. Milwaukee starts Robert Gasser, who has recorded just four and five outs in his two playoff outings, so its bullpen will carry a heavy load. Tampa went 55-26 at home. Both World Series games so far were one-run games. Playable to -130.

Only one of the four Finals games has gone over 149.5, and Game 4 totaled just 129. Both teams are shooting well under 40%, both had top-five defenses, and Golden State plays slow and hit the Under in 16 of 28 home games. SI's pick. We lost the Game 3 Under, the one blowout, so it's half a unit. Playable to 148.

props.reasoning: He's recorded at least 14 outs in all three playoff starts (two earned runs in 16.2 innings), and Tampa needs length from him in a must-win game. He cleared 13.5 outs for us against Cleveland. Expensive, so half a unit. Playable to -170.

sections.label: Baseball
sections.slate: World Series Game 3: Brewers @ Rays, 5:00 PM PT on FOX. Milwaukee leads 2-0 after two one-run wins (3-2, 5-4). Gasser vs Peralta. Rays -120, total 7. Games 4 and 5 are also in Tampa, Tuesday and Wednesday.

straight.reasoning: Peralta (1.08 playoff ERA) at home against a short-leash Gasser. SI and Covers agree. Playable to -130.

parlay.title: Peralta Goes Deep (SGP)
parlay.reasoning: If Peralta goes five-plus innings, Tampa is very likely in control. Correlated, so the book pays less than shown.

props.reasoning: 14+ outs in all three playoff starts. Playable to -170.

sections.label: Football
sections.slate: Monday Night Football: Cowboys @ Eagles, 5:15 PM PT on ESPN/ABC. Dallas -4.5, total 44-44.5. Philadelphia is without Jalen Hurts (backup Tanner McKee starts), DeVonta Smith and Dontayvion Wicks; Saquon Barkley is expected back. Sources split on the side (two take Dallas, Covers takes Philly), so the bets are small.

straight.reasoning: TheLines and SportsBettingDime both pick Dallas. Philadelphia is 1-5 against the spread and missing its starting QB and top two receivers. Dallas converts 47% of third downs to Philly's 37%. Covers argues the other way, since the Dallas offense has stalled lately. Quarter unit. Skip at -5.5.

props.reasoning: He's averaging 96.2 yards a game, and Philadelphia allows the fourth-most receiving yards to wideouts (182.7 a game). TheLines' prop. Quarter unit.

sections.label: Basketball
sections.slate: WNBA Finals Game 5: Dream @ Valkyries, 5:00 PM PT on USA, series tied 2-2. Valkyries -1.5, total 149.5. Atlanta's Brionna Jones is out. Game 6 is Thursday in Atlanta. No NBA picks today.

straight.reasoning: Three of four Finals games have stayed under, and Game 4 totaled 129. Both defenses are elite. Playable to 148.

props.reasoning: Her playoff role is rebounding and finishing, not creating, and Golden State has the league's top interior defense. Yahoo projects 1.94 assists. Quarter unit.
She hasn't cleared this in any Finals game (2, 1, 1, 2 made) and is shooting 29.3% from three in the playoffs against the league's best three-point defense. SI's best prop.
